audit_method: verified by operation (live tool calls, code reads, health probes); nothing inferred from names alone

backend.rendering: Muse-side only. External parties can never render directly; a Muse worker must claim and execute. This is a fixed platform property.

storage.note: Local disk only, no replication. /tmp is ephemeral. Internal absolute paths must never be exposed as accessible references.
retrieval: GET /files/<relpath> — Bearer required; roots limited to projects/, e2e/, tests/; extension allowlist; traversal blocked
dskai_fetch_video / dskai_fetch_image — expiring Muse-storage URLs (TTL service-side, unknown)

tool_catalog.note: REMOTE_AUTH.md claim of '17 tools' is stale.

cancellation.workaround: Mark the request DEFERRED or BLOCKED, or submit a new prompt_revision. There is no cancel/abort tool and notifications/cancelled is ignored.

channel.polling: Worker polls the repo on ~2-minute cadence. No webhook exists; polling is the verified path.
channel.single_writer_assumption: Exactly one worker claims and executes. Claims are idempotent via request_id; reconcile backend job state before resubmission.

lease_until.description: Worker refreshes via heartbeat while active; reclaim allowed after expiry.

description: Machine-readable contract between the external director (Codex/Claude Code, using OpenMontage skills) and the Muse-side worker (Kai) executing generation through DSKAI STUDIO / media-pipeline. GitHub repo sanemelj/OpenMontage-Dskai/dskai-bridge/ is the versioned instruction/result channel.
e2e_validation: PENDING — one real end-to-end test not yet run; evidence will land in dskai-bridge/tests/

aspect_ratio.value: Native output 1152x768 measured; no resolution/aspect parameter exists.

audio_editing.value: No dedicated audio-edit tool. Available: voice previews, audio analysis, audio-QC verdicts, score mix + -16 LUFS normalization inside export.

billing_api.value: dskai_get_budget is a generation-count ledger only; no cost API.

cancellation.value: No cancel/abort op. Use DEFERRED/BLOCKED states or a new prompt_revision.

concurrent_render_capacity.value: Design for serial execution. Independent shots may queue in parallel; measured concurrent-render limit unknown.

dialogue_audio.value: Native in-video dialogue+audio (AAC, measured non-silent). Dialogue is a manifest string field; separate voice-preview flow (real engine clip <=10s); every voice change resets approval.

duration_per_generation.value: <=10.0s measured per single generation. Longer content via chained 10s clips. Duration is a storyboard field, not a job-schema field.

end_frame.value: No end_frame input parameter; absent from job/manifest schemas.

frame_extraction.value: Endframes extracted post-generation with ffmpeg (e.g. *_endframe_for_*_restage.jpg). No dedicated MCP extract-frame tool.

multiple_reference_images.value: references[] = [{character, view, sheet}]; still images only.

start_frame.value: No true start-frame parameter. An approved start-frame image is attached as the primary image reference guiding the first frame.

take_regeneration.value: DONE is terminal. register-shot enforces exactly one registered take. dskai_submit_revision (with recorded strategy_change) is the ONLY legal path to resume FAILED/BLOCKED/DEFERRED.

transient_401_windows.value: dskai-https.py dies silently every ~2-3h (cause unproven, not OOM); keepalive restarts it. Clients MUST retry on 401/connection-refused with backoff.

trimming.value: dskai_timeline trim/split with in/out timecodes; render = pure ffmpeg cut/concat, no regeneration.

implementation_status: PENDING — bridge dirs, poll worker, and media wiring specified but not deployed

aspect_ratio.description: Requested framing. Engine has no aspect parameter (native 1152x768); worker returns BLOCKED with constraint if the brief requires otherwise.

url.description: HTTPS URL the worker can fetch

dialogue.description: Exact spoken text. Never rewritten by the worker.

duration_sec.description: Requested clip duration. Engine limit: <=10s per generation; longer needs chained requests.

project.description: DSKAI project slug (existing canonical projects only unless director was told otherwise)

references.description: Still images only. Delivered as HTTPS URLs (worker fetches) or repo-relative paths.

request_id.description: Idempotency key (uuid). Never reused across distinct creative intents.

constraint.description: Precise engine limit for the director to resolve

media_base_url.description: Current tunnel base. Re-read this file; never cache.

video_url.description: Authenticated HTTPS (Bearer). Valid while the tunnel lives.

rules: Worker never rewrites prompt/dialogue. Creative direction is the director's.
Worker never regenerates an accepted take. A creative change requires a new prompt_revision.
If an instruction exceeds engine capability, worker returns BLOCKED with errors[].constraint and does not guess.

Dependencies with continuity=continuous_action: worker waits for the predecessor's DONE, extracts the actual endframe of the selected take at cut_point_sec, and uses it as start_frame ONLY if supported; otherwise BLOCKED with the constraint.
If a predecessor's selected take changes, worker flags all dependent requests instead of silently continuing.
Concatenation never guarantees continuity. Worker returns actual media; continuity is the director's verdict.
Credentials never appear in the repo. The Bearer token travels out-of-band.
Media URLs are authenticated and tunnel-bound; re-read the result file for the current media_base_url.
No purchases, no publishing, no deletion of canonical work, no CLIENT_APPROVED marking by the worker.
On BLOCKED: report the exact observed failure plus the minimum action needed.
